1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SubdivisionCertificate
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.FlatPetalAgreement
3 
4 /-! The octahedron-minus-edge case keeps its sole quadrilateral diagonal uncut by choosing poles 4 and 5. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
7 
8 open OctahedralTriangles OctahedralNet
9 
10 set_option maxRecDepth 10000 in
11 set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
12 /-- With these poles, the only repeated carrier is one attached fan-petal pair. -/
13 theorem minusEdge_cofacial_indices : ∀ (source : Fin 6), source = 4 ∨ source = 5 →
14     ∀ (slit : Fin 4) (x y : FaceIndex),
15       carrier .minusEdge (OctahedralNet.triangle source slit x) = carrier .minusEdge (OctahedralNet.triangle source slit y) →
16         x = y ∨ (∃ i : Fin 4, x = (false, i) ∧ y = (true, i)) ∨
17           (∃ i : Fin 4, x = (true, i) ∧ y = (false, i)) := by decide
18 
19 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {graph : P.SixVertexGraph}
20 variable {small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
21   (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4} {source : Fin 6} {slit : Fin 4}
22 
23 /-- The two pieces of the quadrilateral use the same placement on the whole original face. -/
24 theorem Development.minusEdge_consistent (net : graph.Development small_faces source slit)
25     (kind : graph.kind = .minusEdge) (poles : source = 4 ∨ source = 5)
26     (x y : FaceIndex) (same : graph.netFace small_faces source slit x = graph.netFace small_faces source slit y) :
27     Set.EqOn (net.place x) (net.place y) (graph.netFace small_faces source slit y).val := by
28   have labels := congrArg (fun F : P.Face => F.vertexLabels graph.vertex) same
29   change (graph.triangleFace small_faces _).vertexLabels graph.vertex =
30     (graph.triangleFace small_faces _).vertexLabels graph.vertex at labels
31   rw [graph.triangleFace_labels, graph.triangleFace_labels, kind] at labels
32   rcases minusEdge_cofacial_indices source poles slit x y labels with rfl | ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩
33   · exact fun _ _ => rfl
34   · rw [← same]
35     exact net.flat_petal_agreement i same
36   · exact (net.flat_petal_agreement i same.symm).symm
37 
38 /-- Every convex solid with this original graph has an original-edge unfolding with its quadrilateral kept whole. -/
39 theorem hasEdgeUnfolding_of_minusEdge (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
40     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
41       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
42     (kind : graph.kind = .minusEdge) : P.HasEdgeUnfolding := by
43   obtain ⟨source, endpoints, source_order⟩ := graph.exists_sharper_pole 4
44   have poles : source = 4 ∨ source = 5 := by
45     simpa only [show opposite 4 = 5 from rfl] using endpoints
46   obtain ⟨slit, maximal, _, _⟩ := graph.exists_curvature_slit small_faces source
47   obtain ⟨net⟩ := graph.exists_development small_faces source slit
48   exact net.hasEdgeUnfolding_of_consistent_subdivision source_order maximal (net.minusEdge_consistent kind poles)
49 
50 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
